# Manufacturing & Industrial Operations / Quality Management & ISO 9001

Build and certify an ISO 9001 QMS, plan and run audits, write NCRs, CAPAs and 8Ds, meet IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP and AS9100 requirements, run SPC, capability, MSA and acceptance sampling, apply Six Sigma DMAIC, DOE and hypothesis tests, and manage supplier quality.

| [supplier-quality-scorecard-builder](supplier-quality-scorecard-builder/SKILL.md) | Build supplier quality scorecards for ISO 9001 8.4 and IATF 16949 8.4.2.4 supplier monitoring: PPM from received and rejected quantities, on-time delivery, responsiveness to corrective action requests, scored 0-100 with configurable weights, a weighted total, A/B/C/D grades, trend against previous periods, and flags for grade D suppliers, two-period declines and PPM above target without a SCAR. Covers KPI definitions (PPM, incidents, OTD window, OTIF, premium freight, disruptions), normalising for low volumes and commodities, grade-to-action rules, the automotive escalation ladder (SCAR, executive escalation, controlled shipping levels 1 and 2, new-business hold, resourcing) and avoiding distorted scores. | `scorecard.py` |
| [incoming-inspection-plan-writer](incoming-inspection-plan-writer/SKILL.md) | Write risk-based incoming (receiving) inspection plans for purchased parts and materials: classify characteristics as critical, major or minor, set the inspection level from supplier grade and lot history (first article and 100% for new parts or suppliers, tightened for grade C/D or repeated rejects, normal c = 0 sampling from LTPD per class, skip-lot for proven grade A suppliers, dock-to-stock with periodic audit), compute c = 0 sample sizes capped at the lot size, and apply switching rules; flags grade D suppliers without an open SCAR and reduced inspection without certificates. Covers certificate (CoC/CoA) review, lot-homogeneous characteristics, what to check at receiving, the plan document format and shifting effort upstream to supplier SPC and source inspection. | `inspection_plan.py` |
| [supplier-corrective-action-request-writer](supplier-corrective-action-request-writer/SKILL.md) | Write supplier corrective action requests (SCARs) and evaluate the supplier's response: when to issue a SCAR, a problem statement with requirement, actual result, quantity and evidence, impact and cost recovery, response deadlines (containment 24-48 hours including stock at the supplier, in transit and at the customer with a clean point; root cause in about 10 working days; closure with effectiveness in 30-60 days). Checks the request for missing facts and loose deadlines, and checks the response for incomplete containment, missing or blame-based occurrence and escape causes, correction- or training-only actions, missing verification, effectiveness, PFMEA and control plan updates or read-across, and late steps; returns accept, accept with comments or reject. | `scar_check.py` |
| [approved-supplier-list-manager](approved-supplier-list-manager/SKILL.md) | Manage and audit an approved supplier list (ASL) / external provider register for ISO 9001 8.4.1, IATF 16949 8.4 and AS9100 8.4.1: supplier status (approved, conditional, probation, pending, disqualified), scope of approval by commodity and process, risk class, certification and expiry, re-evaluation intervals by risk, conditions with end dates, single-source contingency, approver and customer-directed sources. Audits the list for expired or expiring certificates, overdue re-evaluations, conditional or probation status past its decision date, high-risk suppliers without the required certification, single-source suppliers without backup and missing approvers, and checks purchase orders for suppliers that are off-list, disqualified or pending, or buying outside the approved scope. Covers ERP blocks, PO requirements, off-list and emergency purchases. | `asl_audit.py` |
| [supplier-development-plan-writer](supplier-development-plan-writer/SKILL.md) | Prioritise and plan supplier development (IATF 16949 8.4.2.5, ISO 9001 8.4): rank suppliers by spend share, risk, performance gap and single-source exposure; decide develop, replace or monitor; and draft a dated 90-day development plan per selected supplier with kick-off, joint assessment, signed action plan, levers matched to each gap (process control, MSA, capability, problem solving, delivery and planning, APQP/PPAP, quality system, special processes, sub-tier control), on-site verification and close-out, plus PPM, OTD and score targets. Covers the develop-or-replace matrix, signs a development effort will or will not work, governance and records. | `dev_plan.py` |
